_comment: Harness-managed MCP servers, registered at USER scope (all sessions) by install.ps1 via the official `claude mcp` CLI. Source of truth — edit here, not ~/.claude.json.

servers.name: chrome-devtools
servers.why: Live-page performance traces (LCP), DOM/CSS, network/CORS, console and interaction for the Angular/Astro UI + performance lanes. Complements claude-in-chrome (which lacks performance tracing) and satisfies the 80-performance 'measure before/after' rule. Tools are deferred, so they cost no context until loaded.
